text:
If you’re heading out early, bundle up, this is a chilly 36-degree morning in Burlington, but the payoff is a sunny Sunday with a high right around 56. The clouds should give way to brighter skies, though a south wind around 12 mph will keep it feeling cooler, especially along the waterfront. On the broad lake, that wind is running 15 to 20 knots with waves 1 to 3 feet, so this is better for a brief shoreline outing than a casual paddle. The wind builds tonight, even as skies stay clear.

Monday keeps the quiet, sunny pattern and should reach about 61. The forecast models are split by four degrees on the high, with one warmer solution, but I’d stick with the forecasters’ 61 for planning. The lake remains choppy Monday morning, then settles later. Take the warmer afternoon for a walk or bike ride, but dress for the wind today and be off the open water before tonight.
